name: Bruttia Crispina
contribution: Roman empress from 178 to 191 as the consort of Roman emperor Commodus.

checks.lead: Bruttia Crispina (164 – 191 AD) was Roman empress from 178 to 191 as the consort of Roman emperor Commodus. Her marriage to Commodus did not produce an heir, and her husband was instead succeeded by Pertinax.
